rv.q: A sharp blend of humor and horror... this terrific new thriller is the theatrical brew for you.
It's the technical accomplishments that linger in the memory, with a cryptful of artist-magicians in keen collaboration.
Paranormal Activity is an experience that will haunt you – in a thrilling way – well after it’s over.
It lured me in and never let go.
At times it virtually threatens to freeze the marrow in your bones, with an exhilarating freshness of invention.
After several repetitions, the formula becomes somewhat predictable, lessening the impact of what should be the biggest shocks.

cn.t: Critics praise the stage adaptation for successfully translating film scares to live theater through immersive tech and design, blending humor with genuine frights that leave audiences gripping their armrests.
